points: Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers. Jacob prophesied the return of Joseph's seed to the land of Israel, and gave Joseph one portion above his brethren, which he took out of the hand of the Amorite with his sword and with his bow.

note.label: Genesis 48: Ephraim and Manasseh Blessed as Sons of Israel

points: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it: they took them out of the land.

note.label: Numbers 32: The Inheritance of Reuben and Gad on This Side Jordan

points: Rise up, pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle. This recaps Numbers 21, when it was time to destroy the king of the Amorites.

note.label: Deuteronomy 2: Meddle Not With Them, and the Giants That Perished

points: The kings on this side Jordan, in the hills, in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite. These are Hamites, better known as Nilotic Africans.

note.label: Joshua 9: The Gibeonite Deception and the Weight of an Oath

points: The word of the Most High came to Ezekiel to cause Jerusalem to know her abominations: her birth and nativity is of the land of Canaan, her father an Amorite and her mother a Hittite.

note.label: Ezekiel 16: The Harlot Redeemed by an Everlasting Covenant

points: Yet the Most High destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedar and who was strong as the oaks; he destroyed his fruit from above and his roots from beneath. The Amorite is another heathen nation.

note.label: Amos 2: Because They Sold the Righteous for Silver

points: He brought Israel up from the land of Egypt, led them forty years through the wilderness to possess the land of the Amorite, and raised up their sons for prophets and their young men for Nazirites. You can use this to show that the children of Israel are the prophets of the Most High.
